scope: Production UI with isolated synthetic native host and clearly labelled generated test frames; no device acceptance.
checks: Native preparing error, pending geometry and ready pixels recover automatically on the same handle, without an error surface or manual retry.
One in-flight frame per native handle, continuously changing decoded frames and one conversation viewer.
Mobile bottom sheet shares the feed; exact-run pause/resume keeps frames updating; Android back preserves task and composer.
Switching the selected phone discards a late frame and never selects by global activeTaskId.
Hidden document closes native viewer and stops polling; return opens one fresh handle with cursor -1.
Substituted display is rejected, last frame is marked stale, automatic reads stop, deliberate retry stays on original task.
Desktop centered 790px sheet, Escape/focus return and nested task-detail Android back preserve the parent workspace; no duplicate viewer.
Task end releases the feed and labels the retained last frame without reopening or resuming execution.
